result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers define horizontal, stacked and mark-only versions, place them correctly, and handle the avatar and one-color tote well. A is more precise, with proportions tied to the symbol and book height, a minimum size for each placement, margins in mm or cm, and a 2 mm minimum stroke for canvas, so a volunteer can build from it directly. B is sound and adds useful notes on mobile and printer checks, but it leaves more values vague or for the printer to decide. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers set up the same three lockups and assign them sensibly to the four placements. B gives the volunteer more to build from: proportions tied to the mark's height (M) and one book's height (B), and clear space, minimum size, ink and margins for each placement, including a 2 mm minimum stroke for canvas. A is solid and explains its reasons well, but its numbers are looser; its assumption that the mark contains lettering is a minor slip.
